title: Descending twist vanishing step across all closed subschemes
statement: Fix A Noetherian, N and q>0. Assume degree q+1 eventual twist vanishing for every coherent module on every closed subscheme of projective N-space over A. Then degree q eventual twist vanishing holds for every such module on any specified closed subscheme.

proof.text: Choose the short exact presentation S of i_*F with coherent first term and eventually degree-q-acyclic twisted middle term. Apply hnext to the identity immersion and S.X₁. Choose the maximum of its threshold and the middle-term threshold. For such t, O(t) is tensor-invertible, so tensorRight O(t) is an equivalence and preserves the short exact sequence. The pullbackId isomorphism converts the identity-restricted twist in hnext to O(t). Use the source cohomology comparison in degrees q and q+1 to obtain vanishing of ordinary H^q of the middle term and H^(q+1) of the first term. The ordinary cohomology long exact sequence kills H^q of S.X₃ tensor O(t). Transport along the third-term isomorphism and the projection formula to H^q of i_*(F tensor i^*O(t)). Apply the abelian-sheaf affine-morphism comparison to the quasi-coherent twisted F, then the source comparison on X, to obtain the required IsZero in module cohomology.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YS (4), descending induction; D2 combines the short exact presentation with the source-model cohomology comparison and abelian affine comparison to avoid higher-direct-image import cycles

lean.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_closedImmersion_twist_of_next_degree
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hnext : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}}
      (j : Y ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion j]
      (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation],
      ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
        IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace (q + 1)).obj
          (tensorObj F (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict j t))))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj
        (tensorObj F (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict i t)))
